ledger.x: 1918: the German Republic is proclaimed on 9 November 1918; the National Assembly met at Weimar from 6 February to 11 August 1919.

1918: Alsace-Lorraine returns to France 'with effect from the date of the armistice (11 November 1918)'; the Versailles page: the treaty 'restored the provinces of Alsace-Lorraine to France' without a transfer date.
1918: the Allies occupy the Rhineland 'from 1 December 1918 until 30 June 1930'; the British enter Cologne on 6 December.
1918: the Koblenz (American, central) and Mainz (French, southern) zones with the Palatinate occupied from December 1918; the Americans hand Koblenz to the French on 27 January 1923.
1919: the first Polish uprising in Upper Silesia, August 1919.
1920: Northern Schleswig goes to Denmark after plebiscites held in February and March 1920; the transfer date is not on the page, and Cliopatria's 1920 shape still holds it.
1920: Posen and Pomerelia pass to Poland.
1920: the Saar Basin passes to League of Nations control 'for 15 years' after which a plebiscite would decide sovereignty; the start date is not on the page (treaty in force 10 January 1920).
1920: Danzig and its hinterland are ceded for the League to establish the Free City of Danzig; the page gives no date (treaty in force 10 January 1920).
1920: Memel is 'ceded to the Allied and Associated powers for disposal'; the Territorial evolution page adds it was later transferred to Lithuania 'without a vote'.
1921: the Hultschin area goes to Czechoslovakia, 'the transfer was completed on 3 February 1921'.
1922: the fighting over Upper Silesia ends in the partition; the third uprising of April 1921 is the last the page dates.
1923: 'French and Belgian troops entered [the Ruhr] on 11 January 1923'; occupation to 25 August 1925.
1925: the Franco-Belgian occupation of the Ruhr ends, 'evacuation completed on 25 August 1925' (Dawes Plan).
1926: the British leave the Cologne zone in January 1926 (due January 1925, delayed).
1930: 'The last foreign troops left the Rhineland on 30 June 1930', five years before the treaty term; the Koblenz (central) zone had been evacuated in November 1929.

1933: the republic 'effectively dissolved in 1933': Hitler was inaugurated Chancellor on 30 January, the Reichstag Fire Decree followed on 28 February and the Enabling Act passed on 23 March 1933; the constitution was never formally repealed, so the republic 'de jure lasted until 1945'.

wars.name: Silesian Uprisings
wars.outcome: Three Polish uprisings (August 1919, August 1920, April 1921) and the plebiscite of 20 March 1921 (59.61 per cent for Germany) ended in the partition decided 20 October 1921; 3,214 km2 to Poland.

wars.name: Greater Poland Uprising (1918-1919)
wars.outcome: Posen restored to Poland; the treaty ceded the province.

wars.name: Occupation of the Ruhr
wars.outcome: French and Belgian troops entered on 11 January 1923; evacuation completed 25 August 1925 under the Dawes Plan.

certainty.note: Borders pending the treaty; Posen and the Baltic were fought over.
Treaty, plebiscite and commission lines; Eupen-Malmedy fixed in 1922 and recognised on 15 December 1923; the Saar is a League territory until 1935.
